newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Food poisoning outbreak at Colombia tuna factory.
newsitem.headline: Food poisoning outbreak at Colombia tuna factory.

text.p: Scores of workers were taken to a hospital on Friday after a mass outbreak of food poisoning at a tuna packing plant in the port city of Cartagena, Colombian radio said.
Caracol radio network said more than 200 people were overcome by severe abdominal pains, vomiting and diarrhoea after eating contaminated food at the Atunes de Colombia cannery.
A spokesman for the firm declined to comment, saying only that no official information was available from the company.
